dataset.abundance_representation: Wide OTU/feature-by-sample matrices. Each matrix row is one OTU/feature; sample columns contain sequencing read counts.
dataset.zero_representation: 0 means the OTU/feature existed in the source matrix and had zero reads for that sample. A blank means the OTU/feature row was absent from the source file supplying that sample and is intentionally distinct from zero.
dataset.taxonomy_handling: Each OTU/feature references one bundle-local taxonomy_id. The complete Kingdom-to-Species lineage is resolved through biodiversity_taxonomy.csv.

biodiversity_16S.csv.title: ECHOREPO 16S biodiversity OTU/feature count matrix
biodiversity_16S.csv.description: Wide 16S OTU/feature-by-sample sequencing read-count matrix. The first two columns identify the OTU/feature and its taxonomy lineage; remaining columns are ECHOREPO 16S sample labels.

biodiversity_ITS.csv.title: ECHOREPO ITS biodiversity OTU/feature count matrix
biodiversity_ITS.csv.description: Wide ITS OTU/feature-by-sample sequencing read-count matrix. The first two columns identify the OTU/feature and its taxonomy lineage; remaining columns are ECHOREPO ITS sample labels.

biodiversity_taxonomy.csv.title: ECHOREPO biodiversity taxonomy dictionary
biodiversity_taxonomy.csv.description: Lookup table mapping each bundle-local taxonomy_id to its normalized taxonomic lineage from Kingdom through Species.
